title: Status banner
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Status banner that crossfades when the state key changes.

examples.title: Franja de estado

meta.usage: <StatusBanner title="Ready" body="The package can go." stats={stats} stateKey="ready" />

api.name: stateKey
api.description: Crossfade key. Defaults to the title.

docs: Clean-room, domain-agnostic review workflow. The behavior was observed in an unlicensed operations-dashboard demonstration. No source, product name, sample copy, icons, photos, or assets were copied. Labels come from props or a typed config. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. Inverted surfaces use foreground and background. Highlight uses the host primary. The item ships no theme.
